spans.text: [24] AR: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire.

folded.id: man goodness|to|parents
folded.subject: man goodness

spans.text: [8] AR: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ حُسْنًۭا ۖ وَإِن جَٰهَدَاكَ لِتُشْرِكَ بِى مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَآ ۚ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ EN: And We have enjoined upon man goodness to parents.

folded.id: not allah|most|knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?
folded.subject: not Allah
folded.object: knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

spans.text: Is not Allah most knowing of what is within the breasts of all creatures?

folded.id: or|do|those who do evil deeds think they can outrun us?
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us?

spans.text: [4] AR: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَسْبِقُونَا ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ EN: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can outrun Us?

folded.id: people think|that|they will be left to say
folded.subject: people think
folded.object: they will be left to say

spans.text: [2] AR: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ EN: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?

folded.id: sent noah|to|his people
folded.subject: sent Noah

spans.text: [14] AR: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًۭا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ EN: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.

folded.id: that|is|best for you
folded.subject: That

spans.text: That is best for you, if you should know.

folded.id: the answer|of|abraham's people was not but that they said
folded.subject: the answer
folded.object: Abraham's people was not but that they said

spans.text: [24] AR: فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ حَرِّقُوهُ فَأَنجَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: And the answer of Abraham's people was not but that they said, "Kill him or burn him," but Allah saved him from the fire.

folded.id: the day|of|resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another
folded.subject: the Day
folded.object: Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another

spans.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."

folded.id: the land|and|observe how he began creation
folded.subject: the land

spans.text: [20] AR: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ بَدَأَ ٱلْخَلْقَ ۚ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ يُنشِئُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ EN: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how He began creation.

folded.id: the trial|of|the people as [if it were] the punishment of allah
folded.subject: the trial
folded.object: the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah

spans.text: [10] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah.

folded.id: then allah|will|produce the final creation
folded.subject: Then Allah

spans.text: Then Allah will produce the final creation.

folded.id: they endeavor|to|make you associate with me that of which you have no knowledge
folded.subject: they endeavor
folded.object: make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge

spans.text: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them.

folded.id: those|you|worship besides allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision
folded.subject: those
folded.object: worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision

spans.text: Indeed, those you worship besides Allah do not possess for you [the power of] provision.

folded.id: to him|you|will be returned
folded.subject: To Him

spans.text: To Him you will be returned."

folded.id: to me|is|your return
folded.subject: To Me

spans.text: To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

folded.id: we believe|in|allah
folded.subject: We believe

spans.text: [10] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah.

folded.id: when one|is|harmed for [the cause of] allah
folded.subject: when one

spans.text: [10] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَقُولُ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ فَإِذَآ أُوذِىَ فِى ٱللَّهِ جَعَلَ فِتْنَةَ ٱلنَّاسِ كَعَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَئِن جَآءَ نَصْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ إِنَّا كُنَّا مَعَكُمْ ۚ أَوَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعْلَمَ بِمَا فِى صُدُورِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ EN: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah," but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] Allah, they consider the trial of the people as [if it were] the punishment of Allah.

folded.id: who believe|and|do righteous deeds - we will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do
folded.subject: who believe
folded.object: do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do

spans.text: [7] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَحْسَنَ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ EN: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.

[9] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ EN: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].

folded.id: who disbelieve|in|the signs of allah and the meeting with him - those have despaired of my mercy
folded.subject: who disbelieve
folded.object: the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy

spans.text: [23] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَتِى وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ EN: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.

folded.id: worship allah|and|fear him
folded.subject: Worship Allah

spans.text: [16] AR: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ ۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ EN: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, "Worship Allah and fear Him.

folded.id: your refuge|will|be the fire
folded.subject: your refuge

spans.text: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers."
